name: VELOCITY
recent: 公司将于2025年11月28日召开第25届年度股东大会，并已提呈经修订的会议通知。最新财报显示，2026财年第二季度营收环比增长5.7%，但净利润环比下降23.5%，同比大幅下降79.0%。此外，公司于11月4日公告两名董事及审计委员会成员变动。
notable: 将于2025年11月28日召开第25届年度股东大会。
2026财年第二季度营收环比增长5.7%，但净利润环比下降23.5%，同比下降79.0%。
2026年11月4日公告两名董事及审计委员会成员变动。
risks: 净利润同比大幅下降79.0%，盈利明显收缩。
董事及审计委员会成员出现变动。
earnings: 2026财年第二季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收为9,044,000令吉，环比增长5.7%，同比下降11.2%；净利润为1,735,000令吉，环比下降23.5%，同比下降79.0%；净利率为19.2%，低于上一季度的26.5%。

recent_en: The latest financial results show Q2 FY2026 revenue rose 5.7% QoQ but net profit fell 23.5% QoQ and 79.0% YoY. On 4 November, the company announced changes to two board members and its audit committee.
notable_en: The 25th Annual General Meeting will be held on 28 November 2025.
Q2 FY2026 revenue grew 5.7% QoQ, but net profit fell 23.5% QoQ and 79.0% YoY.
Changes to two board members and the audit committee were announced on 4 November 2026.
risks_en: Net profit fell 79.0% YoY, indicating a significant contraction in earnings.
There were changes to board members and the audit committee.
earnings_en: For Q2 FY2026 (ended 30 June 2026), revenue was MYR 9,044,000, up 5.7% QoQ but down 11.2% YoY; net profit was MYR 1,735,000, down 23.5% QoQ and 79.0% YoY; net margin was 19.2%, lower than 26.5% in the previous quarter.
